description: The first v0.09 preregistration helper had an unclosed Python dictionary and failed before writing the approved spec or schemas. Shell redirection created three zero-byte evaluation placeholders; those placeholders were removed and the exact failure is preserved here.
resolution: Split preregistration into smaller deterministic file-generation steps and validate outputs before append/freeze.
regression_action: No new product regression; reinforces existing orchestration/validated-write discipline.
